name: Canopy arthropods from Lower Saxony, Germany (flight interception traps): metabarcoding reads and BOLD matches

affiliation.name: Forest Nature Conservation, University of Göttingen

description: Metabarcoding reads of canopy arthropods, sampled with flight interception traps for four weeks between June and July 2022 in the Solling forest, Lower Saxony, Germany. Includes the raw fastq files and an overview table after initial bioinformatic analyses.

citation.name: Wildermuth B, Seifert C, Husemann M, Schuldt A (2023) Metabarcoding reveals that mixed forests mitigate negative effects of non-native trees on canopy arthropod diversity. Ecological Applications

distribution.name: 2022-264_otu_Table_Wildermuth.xlsx
distribution.description:
The description of the overview table as provided by biome-id:
The results of the taxonomic assignments is provided in an additional file (2022-
264_otu_Table.xlsx) including the OTU number (OTU_ID), the total number of reads per OTU (size), the BOLD reference number of the best matching sequence (Match Ref.), the E-Value generated by the blastn algorithm (E-Value, the lower the better), the percentage of identity between OTU sequence and best match (Identity [%], the higher the better), the length in bases of the matching sequence (Ref. Length), the alignment length between OTU sequence and best match (Overlap, the higher the better), the accession number of the BOLD cluster ID, where the best match is available in BOLD (BOLD BIN ID), taxonomic information for the bast matching sequence (Phylum-Species), country of origin for the best matching sequence (Country) and the number of reads per sample in each OTU (columns P to BH).
All OTUs with an identity value lower than 97% cannot be assigned with high confidence to a species, but to a lower taxonomic level. Missing OTUs could not be assigned to any taxonomic group for the absence of a matching reference.

Additional explanation for columns P-BH: The sample number consists of the sampling site (2-4), the stand type (1-5) and the trap replicate (1-3). Stand types: 1 = Douglas fir, 2 = Beech-Douglas, 3 = Beech, 4 = Beech-Spruce, 5 = Spruce.
